name: Tradable APAC Diversified Finance Provider SSTN
oneLiner: PC0000033 is a KYC-gated Tradable senior secured term note on an APAC diversified finance provider; contract-priced at $1 par, not a liquid stablecoin.
collateral: Senior secured term notes (issued by Victory Park Capital Advisors) backed by an APAC diversified finance provider's consumer-financing receivables (line-of-credit and installment/BNPL) and tokenized through Tradable private-credit issuance rails.
pegMechanism: Contract-priced at $1.00 note par rather than a liquid secondary-market peg; investors rely on issuer servicing and note repayment.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PC0000033 is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

notices.title: Contract-priced private credit
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live $1 price and market cap but zero 24h volume; Pharos treats this as a par-valued private-credit note rather than a liquid stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: PC0000033 is a Tradable-issued senior secured term note on zkSync; tokens are minted only by Tradable's permissioned EOA (0x1b8926…95fe) calling the per-deal contract (0x9a803e…a70), with no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: Tradable issuance EOA (zkSync)
controls.evidence: At zkSync Era block ~49250000, EOA 0x1b8926351fdca73649ba1cf4388aeeffb8cc95fe called deal contract 0x9a803e9d8512f2bd1d7efcab0eb40d8627277a70 which triggered Transfer-from-zero events on 0x6ff4fafd8d604614c704a5936d9146c0af19bd1e. This same EOA is the exclusive minting initiator across all observed mint transactions (20 total events). No proxy admin slot set on token contract.

review.evidence: At zkSync Era block 70747617: all 20 Transfer-from-zero events on the PC0000033 token (0x6ff4fa…bd1e) are initiated by EOA 0x1b8926351fdca73649ba1cf4388aeeffb8cc95fe via the per-deal contract 0x9a803e9d8512f2bd1d7efcab0eb40d8627277a70. eth_getCode confirms 0x1b8926 is an EOA. No proxy admin slot on the token contract. Same Tradable architecture confirmed across all 4 Tradable-issued coins in this batch.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PC0000033 is tracked as a single-chain or natively issued asset for this review, with no source-verified cross-chain route that creates durable supply. Bridge-route scoring is therefore informational and does not add a third-party route penalty.
bridgeRouteRisk.sourceFreeRationale: The tracked Tradable PC0000033 token has one ZKsync deployment; reviewed evidence did not identify a token-specific bridge route beyond chain-level infrastructure.
